item.text: {"search_note":"I found no reliable 2024 evidence on Khamenei’s handling of cyber, biological, or AI risk domains specifically.\nI also found no public 2024 evidence of a precautionary cross-domain risk office, published safety doctrine, incident-reporting regime, or transparency initiative tied to Khamenei.\nBecause the available evidence is overwhelmingly nuclear-specific, any stronger claim about broader dual-use governance would be an inference rather than a sourced finding.","evidence":[{"title":"Iran will not impede IAEA access, head of its atomic organisation says","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-12-14","url":"https://theprint.in/world/iran-will-not-impede-iaea-access-head-of-its-atomic-organisation-says/2403254/","summary":"Iran’s atomic chief said the country would not obstruct UN nuclear-watchdog inspections and would operate within safeguards.
